title: Addition law for the specified common-stage point transports
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D with characteristic p, a prime l different from p, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, and s=Spec k. Use the actual common-stage constructible category on s, its pullbacks P_f, their compositor c(f,h), and the module-valued point fibre V of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. Put g=g_s and g^[r]=g^(r+1). For any object N and a,b≥0, let T_r(N):V(N)→V(P_(g^[r]) N) be the prescribed positive transport iterate. Then T_a(N), followed by T_b(P_(g^[a]) N), followed by V(c(g^[b],g^[a])_N inverse), is T_(a+b+1)(N), after the equality g^[b] g^[a]=g^[a+b+1]. The statement is for the specified restriction-and-coprojection maps and their completed/rational/common-stage comparisons.

proof.text: Use the naturality law for the prescribed common-stage transport iterates and the inverse associativity law for the prescribed common-stage pullback compositor. These isolate precisely the finite/integral/rational/common-stage comparison arguments from the original first step.

Induct on a, simultaneously for every N. For a=0 unfold the positive successor recursion. For a+1 expand the first transport iterate. Naturality moves the preceding inverse compositor through T_b; compositor associativity flattens the two possible triples of pullbacks. By associativity induction, g^[b] followed by g^[a] is g^[a+b+1]. Transport along that equality and apply the induction hypothesis at the one-step pullback of N. The resulting composite is exactly the successor recursion for T_(a+b+2). All equality transports are kept as HEq, and functoriality preserves them.

proof_origin: Agent B4: Lean induction on the first positive index, with scheme-power associativity and heterogeneous functor/composition congruence; comparison naturality and inverse associativity isolated as two genuine constituents of the original first proof step.

theorem transportIterate_add
    (N : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω (Spec (.of D.k))) (a b : ℕ) :
    letI := frobeniusPointPrimeInvertible D l hl
    HEq
      (transportIterate D l hl Ω N a ≫
        transportIterate D l hl Ω
          ((commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω
            (localPositivePower (frobeniusPointIso D).hom a)).obj N) b ≫
        (pointFibre D l hl Ω).map
          (composition l Ω (localPositivePower (frobeniusPointIso D).hom b)
            (localPositivePower (frobeniusPointIso D).hom a) N).inv)
      (transportIterate D l hl Ω N (a + b + 1))
